notes: Golden files use a .golden suffix because .gitignore ignores *.csv and test_p7_golden_covers_every_case requires every committed tests/**/*.csv to have a P7 baseline. The MCP server's no-cell labelling moved into ingest.refusal_parts, shared with the contract; MCP output is unchanged. Thirteen assertions in tests/test_money_in.py that expected a Monzo refusal to quote the cell (e.g. 'someday', 'X1', Amount '10000000000000.00', the Transaction ID) were updated to the contract's line-only wording; the R2 order and content (line, limit, flows read so far) they test are unchanged. Two monkeypatch targets in test_import_flow_totals_and_balance_chain_come_from_the_figures_layer moved to the contract (the walk lives there now; the ingest patches are undone before the importer runs, since the importer's output is now loaded). Kept on purpose: the person's own --opening-balance value is still quoted (an option, not a cell), and the opening balance Monzo's column implies is still named, being the tool's arithmetic needed to mend the option. Behaviour change: `cma import monzo` now refuses (and writes nothing) an export whose converted statement the loader would refuse, e.g. a future-dated row, where it previously wrote a file `cma run` would then refuse.
